card.name: Hospital unit names: intensive care, emergency department
card.fires_on: The second word of hospital unit names, mainly "care" after "intensive" and "department" after "emergency". It appears in drug-label text about admission or inpatient settings.

modes.label: Intensive care
modes.description: The word "care" right after "intensive" in phrases like intensive care unit or facility.
modes.example: Administer Proleukin in a hospital setting with an intensive<< care>> facility.

modes.label: Emergency department
modes.description: The word "department" right after "emergency" when describing where patients were treated.
modes.example: Some patients have required medical therapy in the emergency<< department>>.

card.writes: It pushes toward ward and admission words such as ward, admit and admitting.
card.plain: It marks the end of a hospital unit name like intensive care or emergency department, and leans toward ward and admission wording.
